root_causes.cause: No matrix-core/tensor-core path is being used, limiting math throughput on MI300X.

evidence.interpretation: Tensor/matrix pipelines are completely idle, so matmul runs on non-tensor ALUs with lower achievable throughput.

fixes.fix: Retune/rewrite the kernel to force MFMA-enabled Triton codegen on CDNA3 (use HIP-targeted matmul configs and verify generated ISA contains MFMA instructions for fp16/bf16).
fixes.rationale: Activating matrix cores is the primary path to raise compute SOL significantly for GEMM-like workloads.

root_causes.cause: On-chip memory behavior likely introduces stalls despite full wave occupancy.

evidence.interpretation: Substantial LDS bank conflicts indicate shared-memory access contention, which can stall execution and keep both compute and memory below peak.

fixes.fix: Adjust tile/layout choices to reduce LDS bank conflicts (e.g., try different BLOCK_K/BLOCK_N shapes, add padding/swizzled LDS layout, and re-autotune with conflict-aware configs).
fixes.rationale: Lower LDS contention improves data feed to ALUs and raises effective utilization without requiring more global bandwidth.
